text: Welcome to the Eureka Cycling committee portal walkthrough.
We start at the sign in screen.
Log in with your committee or treasurer account to access the tools.
On the home page, you can confirm your role and check the latest backend status message.
Next is the ledger, where treasurers review monthly transactions, balances, and cash, bank, or card activity.
Financial reports provide year to date and prior financial year snapshots, including income, expenditure, and balance sheet summaries.
Reimbursements let you review recent requests and prepare new submissions with receipts and member payment details.
Documents organizes shared files and folders, with quick access to previews and downloads.
